script:
ssh -i /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-known-hosts ubuntu@172.31.14.72 'sudo /bin/bash -s' <<'H200_PEER'
set -u
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv
nvidia-smi -q -i 0 | sed -n '/Fabric/,/Processes/p' | head -n 16
systemctl show nvidia-fabricmanager.service --property=ActiveState,SubState,ExecMainStatus --no-pager
systemctl show karpo-rps-install-h200.service karpo-rps-h200-prefetch.service --property=ActiveState,SubState,ExecMainStatus --no-pager
tail -n 10 /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-sop-h200-20261120/results/setup/h200-install.log
if test -f /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-sop-h200-20261120/results/setup/h200-prefetch.json; then cat /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-sop-h200-20261120/results/setup/h200-prefetch.json; fi

H200_PEER
